summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to update second quarter 2026 adjusted earnings per share guidance for the combined entity following its May 13 acquisition of Sun Country Airlines. The filing provides no deal terms, price, premium, or structured transaction mechanics; it is purely a preliminary earnings outlook. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock. The update is routine operational guidance, not a special-situations event. What to watch: potential further purchase accounting adjustments.
